newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek equities end 0.37pct up, construction leads.
newsitem.headline: Greek equities end 0.37pct up, construction leads.

text.p: Athens stocks settled 0.37 percent higher on low volume with construction shares leading the advance and analysts said they expected the market to consolidate by end-April.
"The market will stabilise through April. The general share index will fluctuate from 1,200 to 1,300 points," said analyst George Athanasakis at Alpha Securities.

The Athens general share index ended 0.37 percent or 4.77 points higher at 1,280.00 points from Monday's 1,275.23 close after opening at 1278.99. Turnover was 9.0 billion drachmas on volume of 2.8 million shares.
Institutional and retail investors are reshuffling their portfolios based on fundamentals considering current price level attractive, he said.
"Further easing inflation forecasts will lead to a new rise in the bourse in May. Investors are awaiting the outcome of company financial results and particularly dividends," he added.
This rise will be milder than the "exaggerated" January rally, he said.
"Investors' focus is now concentrated on market fundamentals," said Athanasakis.
The banking sector and medium capitalisation stocks will be the strong performers of bourse's rise, he added.
